data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: Class Hierarchy & Tray: • All dialogs inherit from System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog. • Non-visual components: They sit in the Component Tray below the designer canvas rather than directly on the form. Execution via ShowDialog(): • Runs modally: Halts the main form until the user confirms or exits. • Returns a DialogResult value to direct execution flow:

data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value:
Core Execution Pattern: If myDialog.ShowDialog() = DialogResult.OK Then ' Process the user's selection here End If
Standard Built-in Dialog Types: • ColorDialog & FontDialog (Visual Customization)
• OpenFileDialog & SaveFileDialog (File System Access)
• FolderBrowserDialog (Directory Selection)
